_comment: Example window arrangement, in the same format as the windows.json EDLD
writes to your commander's data directory. Copy it there to use it, or
arrange the windows in Preferences > Display and let EDLD write its own.
Slots are addressed <column><position>: A/B/C left to right, numbered top
to bottom. A window may only occupy a slot of its own size class -- panel,
compact or anchor -- so Alerts and Crew/SLF (compact) belong in B2/B3 and
Commander (anchor) in B1. Anything invalid is dropped on load and the slot
The set below is the shipped default: the left column split evenly between
Exploration and Navigation, both of which grow large in use.
Several windows no longer exist on their own, having been folded into
others -- Assets into Commander's tabs, Exobiology into Exploration, the
massacre stack into Session, and Colonisation into Cargo. Naming one of
those here does nothing. Windows left unlisted are simply not shown;
